title: Solariae Management CNIS Plugin
description: Exclusive Solarian Community Plugin for MySQL Database Documentation Management.
body:
**Exclusive Solariana Community Plugin for MySQL Database Documentation Management**  

This plugin was specifically developed for the Solarian community to efficiently manage and organize database documentation within MySQL environments. It offers advanced features tailored for streamlined database operations, ensuring better data structure tracking, enhanced project documentation, and simplified maintenance tasks.  

![Selo de Comprovação](https://imgur.com/a/kyT0GA5)

Key Features:  
- **Automated Documentation:** Capture and maintain database schema changes automatically.  
- **Version Control Integration:** Easily track and revert changes to database documentation.  
- **Customizable Templates:** Generate structured and standardized documentation for tables, procedures, and relationships.  
- **User Access Management:** Define roles and permissions for document editing and viewing.  
- **Detailed Reports:** Generate comprehensive reports for audits and internal reviews.  

This plugin aims to be a valuable tool for Solariana users who prioritize structured and efficient MySQL database documentation management.
